name: Ample Guitar M 4
help: Ample Sound acoustic guitar. Strummers drive Ample's Strummer; pickers play the notes with Ample's techniques (change it with Ample plays, above). The musician sets Ample's modes itself; set Auto Legato to Off in Ample. C3 = middle C. Natural feel: release velocities (leave Auto Off Velocity off), 50 ms onset compensation (Start Time 50 in Settings), hammer-on / slide strum changes, slide-in and harmonic strums, slide-outs, vibrato on held lead notes. Sample Cycle: Separate Cycle for strummers, Round Robin for pickers. Strummer: set Strum Time mode to All (not Each); the sweep speed per stroke comes from this file's strumTimeVelocity - raise lo for quicker strums. Ample's Strum Time = about 1000 ms × (1 − velocity/127); 118 ≈ 70 ms, 124 ≈ 25 ms. Two guitars: give the second a capo in Ample and strumInversion 1 in its player file. Ample chords = Slots: Chord Detect stays off; set Ample's 12 chord slots to the Strummer chord sheet (button) — your voicings, our strokes. A musician on another Idea than the sheet's plays a missing chord from the slot of its root.
